crossRefs.note: “ ‘If you walk contrary to me, and won’t listen to me, then I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to…
then I will also walk contrary to you; and I will strike you, even I, seven times for your sins.
then I will walk contrary to you in wrath. I will also chastise you seven times for your sins.
Those who were full have hired themselves out for bread. Those who were hungry are satisfied. Yes, the barren has borne…
Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.
for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again; but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.
Then Nebuchadnezzar was full of fury, and the form of his appearance was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and…

translations.web: “ ‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.
translations.bsb: And if after all this you will not obey Me, I will proceed to punish you sevenfold for your sins.
translations.kjv: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.
translations.asv: And if ye will not yet for these things hearken unto me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.
